title: ChillFi Mobile App — Master QA Testing Report
subtitle: Every reachable screen of the Flutter app (lib/), in user-journey order, derived from the actual implementation.
scope: Android app (debug build against local backend + Delhivery staging; release build against https://chillfi.in/api).
environment: Pixel 9 emulator 1080×2400 · backend local :5000 · Delhivery STAGING · PhonePe dev/UAT

defects.title: Add-to-cart from listing/offers/deals/trending/new-arrivals/recommended gives no feedback; failures silent
defects.root_cause: onAddToCart callbacks ignored the provider result
defects.fix: Shared addToCartWithFeedback(): green snackbar on success, AppErrorDialog on failure; wired into 6 screens + details/wishlist/deals/recently-viewed

defects.title: Similar products card says 'Added to cart' even when the add fails
defects.fix: Uses addToCartWithFeedback

defects.title: Raw technical/Firebase/Dio text could reach users in snackbars
defects.root_cause: Screens printed e.message / server message verbatim
defects.fix: AppError mapper + Dio interceptor friendly message + AppErrorDialog; firebaseFriendly() code map; voice error text

defects.title: Onboarding One: Skip covered by hero layer and unusable
defects.root_cause: Skip Positioned painted before hero Stack layers
defects.fix: Skip moved last in Stack; Fast Delivery badge moved down so they don't overlap

defects.title: Login: dead language selector; phone field accepts letters and >10 digits
defects.fix: Selector and fake +91 dropdown arrows removed; digitsOnly + 10-digit limit on Login & Sign Up; 6-9 start rule

defects.title: Leftover password UI in OTP-only app (Forgot Password link, reset flow, Sign Up password field that was discarded)
defects.fix: Removed Forgot Password entry and Sign Up password field; reset screens now unreachable (orphans)

defects.title: Sign Up doesn't validate name/phone/email
defects.fix: Name ≥2 chars, Indian mobile regex, email regex when provided

defects.title: Maintenance: dead buttons, hardcoded 'May 18, 2025' downtime
defects.fix: Removed fake card/buttons; Check Again re-reads /app-config and resumes app

defects.title: Home header never shows delivery address
defects.root_cause: Addresses only loaded inside cart flow
defects.fix: Home loads addresses for logged-in users; header tappable; flexible with ellipsis

defects.title: Home header overflowed with longer address label (RIGHT OVERFLOWED stripe)
defects.fix: Flexible + ellipsis

defects.title: White logo on white background invisible (Home header, Maintenance, Login placeholder)
defects.fix: New assets/images/logo_color.png (orange, transparent); login placeholder removed

defects.title: Address picker footer hardcoded 'Deliver to 226010', fake '24-48 hours', dead 'Change Pincode'
defects.fix: DeliveryInfoCard shows selected city/pincode; dead button removed

defects.title: Home cart badge missing until Cart visited
defects.fix: Home init loads cart for logged-in users

defects.title: Voice search: tiny mic target on Home, RIGHT OVERFLOW on voice screen, invisible logo, unclear denied-permission state
defects.root_cause: 22sp tap target; fixed-width Row; white logo; generic status
defects.fix: 48dp target; flexible waves + max-width status; colour logo; clear permission message

defects.title: Home banners ignore admin link (always open all products)
defects.fix: openAppLink() router for /product, /offers, /categories, /products?category=, external URLs

defects.title: Home tiles misaligned; Fast Delivery tile hardcoded ₹499; dead QR scanner icons on Home and listing search
defects.root_cause: Row centre alignment; hardcoded copy; decorative icons
defects.fix: Top alignment; threshold from /app-config; QR icons removed

defects.title: Home advertises coupon CHILL10 which does not exist
defects.fix: Offer card shows best real active coupon from /cart/coupons, falls back to Today's Deals

defects.title: Fake ratings/review counts (e.g. 4.3 / 52,000 reviews with 0 real reviews) shown on app & website
defects.fix: Seed zeroed; scripts/recalc-ratings.js recomputes from reviews (applied locally; production needs approval)

defects.title: Category counts ≠ listing (Audio 8 vs 7); Low Stock products hidden from listings; OOS products not marked
defects.root_cause: Listing default status='Active'; carousels Active-only; no OOS UI
defects.fix: Listing shows all non-inactive; carousels Active+Low Stock; OOS overlay + disabled purchase on card and details

defects.title: 'Best Seller' badge shown for any admin-featured product
defects.fix: Renamed to 'Featured'

defects.title: Offline: logged-in users shown Welcome as if logged out; Home/Categories/Listing spin forever or say 'not found'
defects.root_cause: getMe() treated network errors as invalid session; no error states
defects.fix: Session kept offline with cached profile (only 401/403 logs out); AppErrorState + Try again on Home, Categories, Listing

defects.title: Listing: sort/brand filter only applied to loaded page; Filter button fake; in-page search dead; next page dropped search; 'Popular' sort fake
defects.fix: Server-side sort/brand/price/search on every page; price filter sheet; 'Newest' label; total count from server

defects.title: Product details: dead share button, dead AR button, decorative chevrons, false EMI/Bank/Exchange offers
defects.fix: Share via share_plus; AR/chevrons removed; offers replaced by true payment/return info

defects.title: Reviews: fake 'Verified Buyer'/'Purchased on CHILLFI' badges on every review, fake 'Verified Purchases' summary (any user can review), dead star filters, fake sort, dead helpful buttons, dead Add to Cart/Buy Now, chip overflow
defects.root_cause: Static mock UI; no purchase check
defects.fix: Backend auto-verifies reviews from delivered orders + verified count; badge only when is_verified; server star filter; honest sort label; working bottom actions

defects.title: Price breakdown didn't add up (listed discounted price then subtracted discount again); '1 Items'; '₹1499.00'
defects.root_cause: Label used subtotal instead of MRP total
defects.fix: First row = MRP total on Cart/Checkout/Payment; grammar; rounded ₹ in message

defects.title: SECURITY: order API accepted expired / below-minimum / already-used coupons and silently ignored invalid ones; apply-coupon trusted client order_total; flat coupon could make total negative; inactive/OOS products orderable
defects.root_cause: Coupon rules only enforced in apply-coupon; client total trusted
defects.fix: createOrder re-validates coupon (exists, expiry, min order, per-user use), clamps discount, rejects unavailable items; apply-coupon uses server cart value

defects.title: Addresses accepted invalid phone/pincode (e.g. 12345 / 11000) in app and API; no validation feedback; delete without confirmation
defects.fix: Backend validateAddress (create/update, phone normalised); shared app validator + digit filters + inline error; delete confirmation

defects.title: PhonePe payment page never opened on Android 11+ (canLaunchUrl blocked by package visibility) while app claimed it did; Force-update 'Update' button same bug and pointed to wrong Play Store id (com.chillfi.app)
defects.root_cause: Missing <queries>; canLaunchUrl gate; wrong package id
defects.fix: Manifest <queries> for https/http/upi/market/tel/mailto; launch directly with error dialog + retry; store link → com.ecom.chillfi; iOS guidance

defects.title: SECURITY: payment 'dev shortcuts' mark orders Paid without PhonePe when NODE_ENV≠production (incl. unauthenticated /payment/callback and /dev-success) — any non-prod or misconfigured server gives free orders
defects.fix: Single DEV_AUTOPAY flag requiring NODE_ENV=development AND PAYMENT_DEV_AUTOPAY=true; production verified NODE_ENV=production (safe)
defects.retest: Local verify now calls PhonePe; prod unaffected

defects.title: Auto-cancel after failed payment initiation sends 'Order cancelled' push for an order the customer never saw
defects.root_cause: Cancellation notification fires for system cancels
defects.fix: Suppress customer notification for payment-initiation auto-cancel

defects.title: Bottom nav replaced the whole stack: Orders back arrow → blank screen; system Back on any tab exits app; Orders tab had no bottom nav
defects.fix: Home kept at base, tabs pushed on top; Orders asTab shows nav; maybePop

defects.title: Cancelling a PAID order (customer or admin) created no refund; admin cancel didn't restore stock; admin could reopen Cancelled/Delivered orders; refund/return offered for unpaid cancelled orders
defects.fix: openAutoRefund on paid cancellations; admin cancel restores stock; terminal-state guard; refund rules in app + API

defects.title: Cancel screen Support button dead; tracking title truncated
defects.fix: Support → Help & Support; title 'Track Order'

defects.title: Wishlist Clear All: no confirmation, list mutated while iterating
defects.fix: Confirm dialog; iterate a copy

defects.title: Saved Addresses, Recently Viewed, Help & Support not reachable from profile
defects.root_cause: Links only in unused widget file
defects.fix: Added to profile menu

defects.title: PRIVACY: after logout, guest still sees previous user's address & cart badge; guest profile shows fake 'ChillFi User'; Login back arrow → blank screen after logout
defects.root_cause: Providers not cleared; no guest view; single-route stack
defects.fix: reset() on Cart/Wishlist providers at logout; guest sign-in view; Welcome under Login

defects.title: Invalid email ('bad-email') saved to profile (app + API); duplicate email gave generic error
defects.fix: App + API validation; duplicate-email check

defects.title: Notification toggles had no effect (backend read 'orderUpdates', app saved per-stage keys)
defects.fix: Per-stage mapping in notifyUser

defects.title: Help & Support: dead search box, 'My Tickets'/'View All' coming-soon controls, Account tile just closed screen, FAQs didn't answer
defects.fix: Removed dead controls; FAQ answer sheets; correct destinations

defects.title: About: fake version 2.5.0, invented stats (5M+ customers, 10M+ orders), Terms 'coming soon'; FORCE-UPDATE compared hardcoded 1.0.0 → could lock out up-to-date users; '24x7 support' vs real 9–9 hours (app + website)
defects.fix: package_info_plus real version for About + force update; stats removed; Terms linked; support hours consistent

defects.title: Guest Orders/Wishlist tabs show empty lists instead of a login prompt
defects.fix: Show sign-in prompt for guests

blockers.title: Real phone OTP login (Firebase)
blockers.why: OTP is delivered by SMS to a real phone; Claude cannot receive it. Blocks OTP success + post-login permission screens.
blockers.manual_action: Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method → Phone → 'Phone numbers for testing' → add e.g. +91 9000000001 with code 123456 → tell Claude 'Done'

blockers.title: PhonePe UAT verification locally
blockers.why: Local backend has placeholder PhonePe credentials, so UAT payments can't be completed/verified locally (the old dev shortcut hid this)
blockers.manual_action: Add your PhonePe UAT (sandbox) Merchant ID + Salt Key in LOCAL Admin → Settings → API Keys → Payment (env: UAT). Do not use production keys.
